verdict.rationale: Granola has no documented user-configurable scheduler for recurring jobs. Its automation is event-triggered or fixed: Zapier automation of 'what happens after a meeting', automatic HubSpot sync of folder notes, automatic follow-up email drafts, and built-in overnight pre-meeting briefs. Recurring schedules could be built outside Granola via the API or Zapier, but that requires external tooling. Missing for 10: a native way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows, cron- or interval-based triggers, recurring Recipes or Chat workflows, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
